rationale: C16 supplies a concrete legislative-request template closely matching the child: a letter to congressional leaders recommending that Congress establish a commission to conduct a thorough study of a nationally important industry or system, coupled with preparation or transmission of draft legislation. C24 is a strong secondary analogue for the progression from prior limited studies to the need for a comprehensive review, but it creates an executive Cabinet committee rather than requesting legislation. C03 is substantively close because it assigns telecommunications-policy and radio-frequency functions to the same mobilization office later involved in the child, but it is primarily institutional background and shares less of the child's drafting structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I recommend that the Congress establish a Special Commission on Telecommunications, to be composed of five members appointed by the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I also recommended in my message of March 3 that the Congress establish a commission... to make a thorough study of the coal industry
shared_material.explanation: Both use a presidential letter to congressional leaders to request creation of a special commission for a thorough sector-wide study.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have asked the Director of the Office of Civil and Defense Mobilization to transmit to you a draft of suggested legislation to carry out this recommendation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I attach for the consideration of the Senate (House of Representatives) a draft of legislation to establish a commission on the coal industry.
shared_material.explanation: Both pair the commission recommendation with draft legislation intended to implement it.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It was not possible for the Special Advisory Committee during its brief existence to undertake a thorough and comprehensive study
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The end of the coal strike has in no way diminished the need for a long-range study of the coal industry
shared_material.explanation: Each distinguishes an earlier, limited response from the continuing need for a broader and longer-range commission study.
